title: How Anthropic and Asana Transform Work at Scale with AI Agents
description: Discover how to transform work with Claude-powered AI agents at scale. Tony Chang, AI Studio Product Lead at Asana, will share their real-world journey from early AI experimentation to production-ready AI systems. Then Janak Sevak, Applied AI at Anthropic, will reveal patterns from numerous customer implementations. Learn how AI agents address core enterprise use cases and get actionable guidance on where to start. The session concludes with a live Q&A where you can ask both speakers your questions about implementing AI agents at scale.
